subject: Request: short runway buffer while PO processes (Avalon Health)
messages:
From: Emily Pratt <emily.pratt@avalonhealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot on hold — purchase-order delay, request for short runway credits

Hi Lukas,

Quick update from our side: procurement has flagged the pilot PO for an additional compliance review and the earliest we have for routing is May 20. The pilot environment is scheduled to auto-suspend on May 14 and the team is mid-eval; losing the next week would put the project at risk.

Would Redwood consider a short runway extension (7–10 days) or a small interim credit allocation so we can keep the workload live while legal/finance finish the PO? We can provide the internal requisition number and a note from our procurement lead.

Appreciate any flexibility — we want to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Emily Pratt
Director of Applied ML
Avalon Health

Attachment: purchase_requisition_avalon_4589.xlsx (mentioned)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Pratt <emily.pratt@avalonhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot on hold — purchase-order delay, request for short runway credits

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and for the context. Sorry to hear the PO got pulled into another review.

We can usually support short runway patches in cases like this. Before I propose something formal, two quick asks:
- Can you confirm the internal requisition/PO reference (or the procurement contact who signed the requisition)?
- Roughly how many API tokens are you using per day so we size the top-up appropriately?

Lauren — looping you in for approval of a brief emergency runway. If we can approve a 7-day window and an interim credit (I was thinking ~5k tokens), will that give Avalon the runway they need? If finance needs anything formal I can ask Avalon for the PO number and a note from procurement.

Emily — if you're comfortable, I can get a provisional top-up approved and push the credits to your project by EOD tomorrow once Lauren confirms.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the loop, Lukas.

I spoke with finance on this and we can approve a provisional buffer but want to keep the runway conservative. My recommendation: approve a 7-day extension + 3,000 token provisional credit contingent on receipt of either (a) procurement requisition number by EOD May 14 or (b) a signed MSA/cover email from the procurement lead confirming the PO is in flight.

I've attached the provisional-credit-approval-form.pdf for record keeping — please have the AE fill the Avalon contact and expected PO date. If Avalon can’t meet either condition, we can escalate to Sean for a discretionary exception.

--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisional-credit-approval-form.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-13T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot on hold — purchase-order delay, request for short runway credits

Appreciate the summary. Given this is a mid-market opportunity with clear close intent (deal RDW-4821) authorize: 7-day extension + 5,000 token provisional credit. Condition: Avalon must provide the procurement requisition number or flagged PO number by May 18 and we log the approval against the HubSpot deal. If they miss the follow-through, we’ll re-evaluate and reclaim remaining credits.

Lukas — go ahead and apply the credit and confirm the project id. I’ve bookmarked the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4821.

Sean Gallagher
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

Emily — good news. We’ve approved a 7-day pilot extension and have applied a provisional 5,000 token credit to Avalon Health’s project (RDW-4821). You should see the credits reflected in the Redwood Console within the hour.

Conditions and next steps:
- Please share the procurement requisition/PO number by May 18 so we can finalize the bookkeeping.
- If the PO clears earlier, reply-all with the PO and we’ll mark the top-up against it.
- Attachment: topup-invoice-stub.pdf (for your records)

Hope this keeps the team moving — ping me if anything breaks.

Best,
